confidence_explanation: The evidence shows a clear pattern of an insider threat (user_04) performing unauthorized data collection. The user, a junior accountant with read-only access, bypassed their departmental scope to download files from Engineering, Legal, Executive, Security, and DevOps directories, accompanied by multiple bulk download alerts.

attack_chain.description: User_04 begins cross-department access by downloading files from the shared runbooks directory.
User_04 accesses and downloads sensitive files from the Legal department.
User_04 accesses and downloads files from the Engineering (Project Alpha) directory.
User_04 accesses and downloads files from the DevOps logs directory.
User_04 accesses and downloads files from the Executive directory.
User_04 accesses and downloads files from the Security directory.

gaps: Lack of information regarding whether user_04's account was compromised by an external actor (credential theft) vs. a malicious insider.
No information on the destination of the downloaded files to confirm exfiltration to an external endpoint.
narrative: User_04, a junior accountant, performed an extensive unauthorized data collection operation. After logging in during off-hours, the user systematically downloaded a large volume of files across multiple departments, including Legal, Engineering, Executive, Security, and DevOps, which is entirely outside their normal scope of work.
